note: Thirteen tickets went through triage this morning. Six were pushed to high priority - a locked-in passport, a same-day inspection, a trip hazard, a drifting walk-in cooler, a VIP arrival on a sticking balcony door, and a jammed blackout blind for a day-sleeper guest. The walk-in cooler job is held for the chief engineer's sign-off since it is over the contractor threshold, and one light-switch report could not be scheduled because its room is not on today's board. Everything else is booked across Nuno and Marta before the end of the day, with three low-priority jobs rolled into Friday's planned-maintenance round.
headline: 13 triaged, 6 escalated, 1 held for sign-off, 1 unscheduled
